description: Documentation descriptor for the pickle-free NPZ produced by save_dataset(), not a measured dataset or a physiological validation claim.

array_requirements.rotations: float[T,J,3,3], proper local rotations in checkpoint joint order
array_requirements.actuator_names: unicode[A], unique exact native muscle actuator names
array_requirements.state_FEATURE: optional float[T,A], explicit declared supported physiology field
array_requirements.reference_FEATURE: float[A], required for each included FEATURE
array_requirements.baseline: float[T,V,3], released baseline unposed into canonical corrective coordinates
array_requirements.target: float[T,V,3], registered observations in those same coordinates
array_requirements.observation_weights: float[V], nonnegative confidence; zero marks unobserved vertices
array_requirements.subject: unicode[T], stable subject IDs
array_requirements.motion: unicode[T], complete recording IDs, not frame IDs

metadata_requirements.provenance: Required nonempty description of geometry and physiology origin
metadata_requirements.measurement_protocol: Required evidence for eligibility for external validation; unavailable for the synthetic fixture
metadata_requirements.baseline_checkpoint_sha256: Recommended hash of the exact released baseline checkpoint
metadata_requirements.baseline_rigid_checkpoint_sha256: Recommended hash of the exact rigid companion checkpoint

validation_rules: Only include feature_units for states that are genuinely supplied.
MuJoCo actuator_length and actuator_velocity are musculotendon transmission quantities in the supported muscle models, not fiber measurements.
Pose-only data cannot train physiology-conditioned correctives.
Hold out entire subjects, motions or load conditions; no random adjacent-frame split.
Skin observations do not validate unobserved internal muscle surfaces.
All artifacts remain physiologically_validated=false in this research pipeline.
Synthetic artifacts require an explicit export opt-in and must remain labeled synthetic.
